# ArduPilot fixture

`sitl-copter-4.6.3.bin` was produced for this project with ArduPilot's software-in-the-loop simulator
(ArduCopter 4.6.3, git 92b0cd78, frame QUAD/PLUS): takeoff in GUIDED, LOITER, RTL and landing.
The simulator was stopped while the logger was writing, so the last message is cut off, as in many real logs.
It contains no third-party data; it is part of this project.
